task.speaker: client
task.text:
Hi Marissa,

The landing-page engagement can go ahead, so I will hire you for that. We can leave the UI/UX discussion until our meeting.

I probably made that second area sound broader than intended. At this stage, I only want to agree on and style the main UI-shell components—the header, side navigation panel, and footer—including their fonts, colors, icon styles, and treatment in both light and dark modes. Settings, monitoring logs, provisioning, applications, and the other screens will sit within the main canvas and evolve over time. Their styling is a separate, though very important, question.

Derek
